description: This file defines classes and structures related to MPEG tables, specifically Program Association Table (PAT) and Program Map Table (PMT), used in MPEG broadcasting. It includes class definitions, iterators, and methods for parsing MPEG section data.

classes.name: PAT
classes.description: Represents the MPEG Program Association Table, providing access to transport stream ID and program list.

classes.name: ProgramIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing programs within the PAT.

classes.name: PMT
classes.description: Represents the MPEG Program Map Table, providing access to program details and streams.

classes.name: StreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing streams within a PMT.

methods.name: TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the PAT.

methods.name: Programs
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the programs in the PAT.

methods.name: ProgramNumber
methods.description: Returns the program number for the current program in the iterator.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the PID for the current program in the iterator.

methods.name: Streams
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the streams in the PMT.

methods.name: StreamType
methods.description: Returns the stream type of the current stream.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the PID of the current stream.

methods.name: Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors of the current stream.

methods.name: ProgramNumber
methods.description: Returns the program number of the PMT.

methods.name: PCRPid
methods.description: Returns the PCR PID of the PMT.
